description: Returns the right channel for a request for quotation (RFQ): the transformer configurator deep link (pre-filled with the product name), the contact page, e-mail and phone numbers, office hours and the one-business-day response commitment. This tool stores nothing and sends nothing — the user completes the request on entogo.ca or by e-mail.

product.description: Product name or id the user is interested in

summary.description: One-paragraph project summary to paste into the form
